subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Warranty Extension Call
description: A 60-second lesson on The Warranty Extension Call.

hook.text: Your car's warranty is about to expire. A caller wants to help you extend it — for a fee.

buildup.text: Warranty extension scams use robocalls to reach millions. They sound official and urgent.

discovery.text: The 'warranty' they sell is either worthless, full of exclusions, or from a company that doesn't exist.

twist.text: Americans received over 5 billion warranty scam robocalls in a single year.

climax.text: Real manufacturers and dealers never cold-call about warranties. If they call you, it's a scam.

punchline.text: Your warranty is fine. The call is the real problem.

quiz.question: How do real manufacturers handle warranty extensions?
options: They never cold-call — legitimate offers come through dealers
